# CQLite

> Local Apache Cassandra SSTable access without cluster dependencies. Reads Cassandra 5.0 SSTables directly from disk — no cluster, no JVM required.

## Documentation Sets

- [Abridged documentation](https://pmcfadin.github.io/cqlite/llms-small.txt): a compact version of the documentation for CQLite, with non-essential content removed
- [Complete documentation](https://pmcfadin.github.io/cqlite/llms-full.txt): the full documentation for CQLite

## Notes

- The complete documentation includes all content from the official documentation
- The content is automatically generated from the same source as the official documentation
